about: Big cultural and golf moments the content plan builds around (John, 19-20 Nov 2026: plan ahead for GTA VI, Avengers: Doomsday, Christmas and the like). The moments planner (Claude, 1st and 15th) keeps this 90 days ahead, verifies dates, and for EACH moment chooses its own format and look to suit the event and what's working on social right now. The GTA VI collage was right for GTA only; no format is the default. Original design only: never a film's, game's or brand's logo, artwork, characters or lettering.
